statement: On a given day, the construction a person sees on NYC streets is mostly not new buildings: active sidewalk-shed permits outnumber active new-building jobs, and most sheds stand on lots without an active new-building job.

graph_evidence.summary: Population growth rate and expansion rate of construction land, Chongqing over 20 years (coefficient 1.82; doi:10.1117/12.815931). The only construction-supply finding found in the graph.

Vacant housing demolitions and change in crime, mean difference -0.068 (CI -0.119 to -0.018), PMID 36228876. Shows the graph treats land and buildings as exposures for health and crime, not as supply outcomes.

Variable and concept searches (13 terms, data/derived/construction/graph_search.json) found no finding on building permits, permit-to-completion ratios, lags or permit lapse. The construction concept (COEFxSZVXO) has 3 relationships in all (wage, population growth, natural disasters).

literature.citation: NYC Department of Buildings, 'Get Sheds Down' plan (July 2023) and press coverage
literature.finding: About 9,000 sidewalk sheds, roughly 400 miles, stood in the city in 2023; many stand for years, often for facade work under Local Law 11 (FISP).

prediction.magnitude: Reference date 2026-11-01. Active sidewalk-shed permits (DOB NOW Build approved permits with work type Sidewalk Shed, issued on or before the date and expiring after it, counted by distinct job filing): 6,000 to 11,000. Active NB jobs (an NB work permit issued and unexpired on the date, in either system): 1,500 to 5,000. Ratio sheds/NB between 1.5 and 6. Share of active sheds on a BBL with an active NB job: 5% to 25%.
prediction.support_if: ratio of active shed jobs to active NB jobs > 1.2 AND share of sheds on NB lots < 0.35
prediction.refute_if: ratio < 0.8 or share of sheds on NB lots > 0.5

plan: SoQL on rbx6-tga4 (work_type for sidewalk sheds; NB work permits via job_filing_number joined to w9ak-ipjd job_type 'New Building') and on ipu4-2q9a (legacy NB permits still active, expiration_date after the date). Count distinct jobs active on 2026-11-01, plus a monthly series of active shed and NB jobs 2022-2026 if queries allow. Join on BBL for the overlap share. Also count active alteration and facade (FISP, xubg-57si) work for context. Figure: bar chart of active jobs by kind on the date.
alternatives: Permit 'active' status overstates sheds actually standing (sheds removed before the permit expires) or understates them (sheds standing on expired permits)
Sheds per job differ (one job may carry several shed permits along a frontage)
Perception is driven by cranes and tall towers, not by count of sites
